A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Connect threatened groups or sacrifice them for outside influence; start a capture race, invade, or secure two independent eyes. Occupying an empty point can save one group while taking a liberty from another.

Take a seat
How to play
7×7 intersections. Alternate placing stones or passing. Orthogonal groups with no empty neighboring liberty are removed after enemy captures resolve. Suicide prohibited; positional superko prevents repeat boards. Two consecutive passes enter explicit territory scoring with disputed groups played out, never guessed dead. Area = stones plus empty regions bordering only one side; compensation displayed before play.
Higher area after agreed double pass wins, equality draws; opponent area win is a natural loss. Resignation optional but never failure evidence.
